verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection platform. Versioning or rolling back user configurations is a plausible question for such a platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of automations, connections, or published servers. Triggers, namespaces, and CLI add/remove commands are adjacent features and give no version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
